verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's core value proposition is document-grounded chat: docs and GitHub describe attaching documents to build a knowledge base with local embeddings/vector stores, and hands-on community reports confirm using it to chat with docs (e.g., testing regulatory PDFs) with citations, though one user noted citation snippets were sometimes garbled. Missing for 10: no rigorous accuracy benchmarks or larger-scale independent evaluation of retrieval quality beyond a single anecdotal test.
